mapper.select: select stock_price from inv_stock_store where store_code=#{storeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and goods_code=#{goodsCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select business_qty from inv_stock_store where store_code=#{storeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and goods_code=#{goodsCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT pag.price_including_tax FROM pur_agreement pa INNER JOIN pur_vendor pv ON pa.vendor_id = pv.id AND pv.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN pur_agreement_goods pag ON pa.id = pag.agreement_id AND pa.is_delete = 0 AND pag.is_delete = 0 WHERE pag.goods_code = #{goodsCode} AND pv.vendor_code = #{vendorCode} AND pa.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} AND pag.start_date <= #{day} AND pag.end_date >= #{day} limit 1
